scientific_integrity: General result proved with integral weak Lefschetz, Pieri, Poincare duality and affine-paving ranks; finite checker is corroboration rather than infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Smooth general pencils over C; odd biisotropic two-plane subfamily only. No claim for k>2, singular pencils, positive characteristic or quantum cohomology. Earlier additive Betti and degree results are credited. Implicit prior coverage remains a historical-priority risk.
title: An integral cohomology and Chow ring presentation for odd biisotropic two-plane Grassmannians
